d.ko: War for the Overworld is an unholy union of Dungeon Management and Strategy that rewards all those villainous thoughts you’ve been having. Craft your own perilous dungeon and defend it against pesky heroes who keep exploring it and taking your stuff.

d.zh: 《地下城争夺战》是一款融合了地下城管理和策略玩法的邪恶大作，专门满足一肚子坏水的玩家。亲手打造危险重重的地下城，抵御不断擅闯、还顺走你东西的烦人英雄们。
